data_models.name: Link
data_models.note: Owned by save-link feature; this feature adds no columns

api_endpoints.purpose: List all saved links newest first
api_endpoints.response: JSON array of Link objects, empty when no links stored

components.name: LinksList
components.note: Displays saved links in reverse chronological order

acceptance_criteria.text: The system shall return 200 and a JSON array from GET /links, empty when no links are stored.
The system shall order listed links most recently created first.
The system shall include every stored link in the listing, reporting a null title rather than omitting an untitled link.
If the stored links cannot be read, then the system shall return 500 and shall not return an empty array, so that a failure to read is never reported as an empty shelf.
